column3: All vexillary involutions; both B sets and GC polynomial are deferred to paper. A uniform support-expansion argument is required; finite I11 verification supplies no such mechanism.
Every g>=2 and partition of g-1; normalized BGW number C is not defined. Extremal partitions alone do not control intermediate partitions without an order-preserving recurrence.
Every g>=1 and ordered pair of partitions; C is undefined. Strict ordering needs comparisons across both length and lexicographic blocks, stronger than extremal nesting.

Every A,B in stated power sets; fusion, antiset and meta-space operations are undefined. Product counting is attractive only if disjoint coordinate states and uniqueness are proved from actual definitions.

Every even k>=8 and n>=0 except n=k+1; hooks in partitions with no even parts give exact coefficient formulation. Uniform coefficient positivity needs an injection or generating-series domination, not the reported bounded checks. Conflicting resolution metadata is not a proof-body finding.

Every regular local R and proper ideal I; T_i is named but its construction is not specified. Eventual vanishing to complete intersection is the substantial direction; no small finite certificate or short full-scope bridge established.
All 34 lattices, but neither lattices nor fields are supplied. Universal representation cannot be tested or proved for the missing objects; no replacement.

Every n>=11 requires a circulant of diameter two and monophonic position two; monophonic position is not defined. Need one construction covering all residues and induced-path control for every triple.

All positive s,n,k and an absolute C; scope of existence of C and feasibility when s>n are not cleanly separated. First sharp thresholds and second error thresholds are different uniform assertions; no general cross-matching mechanism established.

Every n, Boolean f and crossover probability in [0,1]; the channel and entropy specify the inequality. Data processing only gives I<=1 and does not yield the sharper entropy loss uniformly; local balanced results do not settle all f.
Every j>0 in each of 42 families; families, breadth and complexity convention are not specified. Minimal triangulation lower bounds cannot be reconstructed from the upper bound alone.

Every n>=0 and four residues modulo225; ped is defined by partitions and a generating product. Finite coefficients cannot prove all n; modular-form or recurrence certificate would require exact level, weight and divisibility reduction.

Every n>=0,k>=1; nonoverlined parts not divisible by6 define the overpartition count. Infinite powers-of3 family requires a stable extraction recurrence modulo128; verifying small k cannot establish it.

Every prime p>=5 with Legendre(-2/p)=-1, positive t coprime6 divisible byp, n>=0 and 1<=j<p. Index is integral since t is odd. Need uniform modular identity for arbitrary prime and t, not a fixed progression check.

Every prime p must have finite J_p of harmonic numerator divisibilities. Recursion H_(pn) connects p-adic valuations but does not uniformly terminate all branches; bounded prime computations are insufficient.

Every shifted skew shape; signed permutation, coefficients and deformed functions depend on source definitions. Conditional implication from Type C expansion is not an unconditional positive expansion proof.

Universal template equivalence is corrupted into repeated d4a2 identifiers, undefined d52f/d53d and missing Assumption. Cannot tell distinct graphs or quantify dynamics; no replacement or literal tautology credit.

Every n>=0,i>=1 in five progressions; indexed overcubic partition function is deferred to paper. Need exact generating series before congruence testing; stated similarity to preceding proof is an objection to novelty, not a proved subsumption bridge.

Every smooth rational hypersurface n>=4,d>=3, every epsilon>0 and height bound B, with constant uniform in X. Standard projective height understood; determinant-method estimates must maintain this uniformity. Large-degree or X-dependent estimates do not cover full statement.

Every order n: regular graph with pairwise nonisomorphic induced links iff n>=12. Need both exclusion n10,11 and constructions for every n>=12; isolated examples or disjoint unions duplicate links and do not establish the threshold.

Every graph and real p>=2; edgeless graphs give 0/0 energies and need exclusion or a convention. On nonempty graphs intermediate p requires a vector-coloring spectral inequality, not interpolation from only the two endpoints.

Every simple drawing and every a,b; distinct endpoints and small-n conventions are omitted. In intended distinct-vertex range, rerouting must avoid all crossings simultaneously; bounded SAT checks do not give an arbitrary-n construction.

Every convex drawing and plane matching; convex drawing has a specialized topological meaning absent here. Straight-line hull arguments cannot be applied without the relevant face-convexity definition.

Every integer k>=1 and prime p>17; Gaussian rational denominators are p-units by the summation restriction. Universal k appears vulnerable to finite-field exponent periodicity, but any missing exponent restriction is a wording/domain correction, not eligible discovery credit.

Every triple and epsilon>0; normalization, ordering of arc distances and epsilon-close metric are omitted. Permutations and rescalings cannot be counted as mathematical counterexamples; classification needs exact source convention.

Every alpha>=1 and prime p>=5 other than13, some k(p,alpha), then all integer N; negative powers of p are units modulo13^alpha. Statement itself reports a proof, so retain public-resolution objection pending actual body; no novelty claim.

Every prime fibered positive knot; coefficient field F and grading convention for knot Floer group are unspecified. Computed crossings do not control arbitrary monodromy or homology; no full-scope mechanism established.

Some absolute c>0 for every finite R and subgroup T; count all intermediate subgroups using index and its prime-factor multiplicity. Greedy relative generators offer an elementary counting bound; assess that bridge before any serious novelty investment.
Every positive ell; ell-minimal and the sparse stretched clique class require source definitions. Forty examples at ell4 do not certify arbitrary rank or edge minimality.
Every real r>2; fractal C^r is entirely deferred. Lattice self-similarity alone is not a complete nonmeasurability proof without verifying geometric hypotheses and possible cancellations.

Every beta in[0,1] and degree>=2 polynomial, but c approximately0.233 is not an exact quantified threshold. Beyond this precision issue, all-degree quadratic improvement needs uniform critical-root control; no route from fixed degrees established.
Every n>=10 but D_n^2 has no edge definition. A toroidal representation neither proves nor refutes planar transparent-rectangle representability; missing family retained.

Every nontrivial 2-plat 2-knot; parameter construction F(p,q) and allowed q are absent. Nonmonicity would suffice only with exact Alexander polynomial formula and a full-parameter argument, not p<=2000.

Every n>=0; sequence alphabet is corrupted as 71. Intended +/-1 alphabet cannot be silently substituted; even intended base-sequence existence is an infinite construction problem stronger than available small n.

Every prime p, morphisms over an unspecified rational field and targets genus>=2; small-genus source levels may have no qualifying quotient. Need genus restriction and exact isomorphism equivalence before classification; no endpoint correction credit.

Some regular homotopy of sphere immersions, every time t; Willmore normalization and admissible regularity are unstated. Lower bound from quadruple points does not construct a homotopy attaining it at all times.
Every n>=11, some graph attaining the stated orientable-genus complement sum. Requires simultaneous embeddings for all remaining congruence classes; known residue families cannot be extrapolated.

Uniform convergence for all starting y0, but chi, density and suitable function class are absent. Periodic points could obstruct it for many maps, yet no map-specific counterexample may be asserted; prime-gap speculation is not a proof.

Every r>=2 and every finite minor of reversed quasi-Eulerian triangles; entries and convention for total positivity are absent. Leading50 blocks do not control infinite minors; need production-matrix or network factorization.
Every k>=1; graph cocycle, leading-term projection and graph-complex conventions are deferred. Nonzero cocycle coefficients alone do not establish non-boundary classes at arbitrary loop order.

Every massive-module parameter set obeying the displayed nonvanishing for all n; algebra and summands are not defined. Direct-sum decomposition gives no indecomposability of either summand without an endomorphism or submodule argument.

Every n>=4 lower bound and n>=92 exact formula, residue-dependent d; similarly ordered is undefined. Need determinant-sign characterization for all separated Farey pairs, not numerical equality at finite n.
Every n>=1, but recursive psi_n polynomials and coefficient ring are missing. Equality requires no cancellation among partition-indexed monomials; the upper bound does not give that property.

Every n>=0,alpha>=1 with exact infinite-product K; congruences require uniform7-adic extraction. Statement reports that source proves it; public-resolution objection means no discovery proposal without body checks.

Every homological q; algebraic transfer is named but domain/codomain and internal-degree conventions absent. Literal reports a refutation in bidegree(6,42), so no new discovery should be inferred from the open tag.

Every n>=0 and prime q, seven residue congruences for overpartition q-tuples. Prime2 must be included literally; dissection identities may separate odd q and q2. Need exact all-q identity rather than parameter examples.
Every knot; theta Laurent polynomial construction absent. Need a diagrammatic or surface filtration with degree bound uniform over knots; crossing checks give no genus proof.

Every fiber t but admissible t, normalization of singular fibers and C_(7,t) are not given. Elliptic curve CM convention also needs coefficient-field clarification; missing objects prevent the Hodge summand assertion from being self-contained.

Every prime p>=3 and unit q; torsion invariant tau is not defined. Orbit invariance is only forward direction; need exact algebraic reconstruction of q orbit from invariant, not finite p computations.

Every odd prime p, some primitive root k with k^2+4 nonsquare. A multiplicative-character expansion might control large p, but uniform small-prime cutoff and possible zero values need treatment; no complete short proof established.
